semantic_inputs: public: Hao et al., E-values for k-Sample Tests with Exponential Families
actions: Verified PACE's primary-source paired e-process, default alpha/lambda, per-candidate guarantee and explicit non-claim of run-level control.
Derived exact parameter translation lambda=0.5 <=> fixed sign bet a=0.75.
Derived posterior nuisance-discordance-rate mixture projection that uses rho only for predictable bet selection while retaining sign-only e-validity.
Ran 250000 alternative and 250000 null trajectories per each of seven discordance schedules at T=50 for selected policies, including outcome-adaptive schedules.
Persisted checkpoint and advanced role-local LATEST.
material_findings: PACE is a direct empirical agent application of the paired sign e-process but explicitly guarantees only per-candidate control conditional on the candidate evaluation stream; loop-level adaptive reuse is empirical, not theoretically covered.
PACE default fixed lambda=0.5 can be power-brittle under low-when-ahead discordance schedules despite remaining anytime-valid.
Low-rho posterior mixtures improve the robustness/typical-power tradeoff; no single reference policy is uniformly best across the stress-test family.
termination: physical invocation boundary after durable checkpoint; research frontier remains nonempty and this is not task completion
exact_next_action: Analyze the reused finite dev-set/adaptive-candidate-generation gap: determine when the within-candidate conditional sign null remains defensible after the same dev set has already steered earlier proposals, and compare fresh-audit/reusable-holdout/run-level e-value remedies.
